parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/infrastructure/app.ts is an Express HTTP adapter and composition root. It routes requests, parses and type-checks raw request input, shapes responses (toDto turns dates into ISO strings), maps domain errors to HTTP status codes, and wires the in-memory repositories into the application service. All of these are infrastructure (transport/framework) responsibilities. The status and assigneeId checks only validate the shape of the request and delegate status membership to the domain predicate isTaskStatus, so they are input parsing, not business rules. Business operations (create, assign, complete, filter) are left to TaskManagementService.
